questions.questionText: Which hook is used to handle side effects in a React functional component?
questions.explanation: useEffect is the primary hook for side effects like API calls and DOM manipulation.

questions.questionText: Which of the following is true about Virtual DOM?

options.A: It is a direct copy of the real DOM
options.B: It is slower than the real DOM
options.C: It is an in-memory representation of the UI
options.D: It updates the entire page on every change

questions.explanation: The Virtual DOM is a lightweight copy of the real DOM used by React to compute minimal updates.
